The situation reached a crescendo during the fifth inning of the Cubs’ 7-0 win Monday. results.title: Former Grossmont High School employee arrested for alleged relationship with student

results.title: Crushers outslug Y’alls, 7-5
results.description: Luis Acevedo doubled, had a solo home run in the second and drove in three runs amid a 3-for-5 night to lead the Crushers to a 7-5 win over the Y'alls in Florence on Aug. 25.
